jyutping: A jung6 dak1 noi6 gwo3 B

english.note: Use this for an object, appliance, or other thing that stays usable longer than B.

examples.english: This washing machine will outlive that one, so it is much better value.
examples.traditional: 呢部洗衣機用得耐過嗰部，抵買好多。
